concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-docs-guides-sepa-direct-debit-overview]] - 2026-09-16 unversioned Braintree website overview for pilot-only SEPA Direct Debit eligibility, hosted mandate acceptance and management, account-configured settlement modes, country scope, regulatory notifications/cancellation and non-guaranteed return/dispute lifecycle; complementary to the narrower payment-method guide, and not current support, exact API/SDK behavior, merchant enablement or successful debit, settlement or funding proof
warnings: Keep this overview distinct from the existing narrower SEPA payment-method guide and from ACH Direct Debit or card lifecycle rules.
Mandate acceptance, IBAN validation, a debit request or Instant Settlement wording must not be presented as successful debit, irreversible settlement or guaranteed funding.
